Where you touch the institutional axis, own ONLY the QUANTITATIVE structural-demographic subset — a per-country RATIO of elite-aspirant-count to elite-position-count whose surplus feeds EliteFracture — which a scalar institutional-health knob cannot express (overproduction is not low health; it is too many healthy claimants for too few seats), and hand the recoverable-scalar lifecycle/hollowing/trust framing to that lens.

Do NOT own or re-derive the portfolio-ranking METHOD itself (the structural categories, the collapse-literature-weight and eval-value columns, the sort discipline) — that is fd-societal-layer-gap-ranking / the comparator-coverage-audit lens's spine; feed it elite-overproduction (aspirant/position-ratio) host+cost rows for the institutional-dynamics axis rather than re-deriving the ranking framework.

Own exclusively: the elite-OVERPRODUCTION-as-RATIO blade (aspirant-count vs. position-count), the PROSPERITY-BREEDS-ASPIRANTS coupling (aspirant-supply rising in good times — the counter-intuitive Turchin signature), the fixed-or-slowly-growing POSITION DENOMINATOR, the ELITE-CIRCULATION relief (thinning the surplus), the aspirant/position-ratio modulator on the existing institutions-pillar EliteFracture emission as host, and the collapse-into-one finding that education (feeding the aspirant numerator) and religion (feeding counter-elite mobilization) may wire through ONE overproduction-ratio host. Concede tempo/shear to masonry, felt-regime to maqam, conserved-stock network breach to terraced-paddy, irreversible latch to felt/fulling, recoverable institutional lifecycle-scalar to the institutions lens, and the ranking method to the ranking lens.
spec.decision_lens: For the elite-overproduction axis and any structural-demographic candidate, ask: does the sim carry a COUNT OF ELITE POSITIONS (a denominator) and a STOCK OF ELITE ASPIRANTS (a numerator), or is EliteFracture only a magnitude a pillar injects with no ratio behind it? Does aspirant-supply RISE with prosperity (the Turchin signature that good times breed the surplus that later fractures the state), or does a good economy only ever reduce pressure? And can the surplus be RELIEVED by elite circulation (thinning / opening positions / downward mobility), or, absent a circulation channel, can an overproduction only climb? Rate P0 if the elite-overproduction / elite-circulation axis is entered into f-007 as a mandated institutional-dynamics candidate with a collapse-literature weight and eval value, scored as if the sim can express its defining dynamic — a surplus of unplaced elite aspirants (produced faster in prosperity) turning into counter-elites that fracture the state — but the inventory shows EliteFracture is only ever an additive magnitude emitted by the institutions pillar's per-tick shadow `leadership_pressure` (inventory §8, institutions/pillar.rs:108-313), institution effectiveness/legitimacy are frozen scalars never mutated (§8), and there is no count of positions, no aspirant stock, and no channel by which prosperity RAISES aspirant-supply (§2 additive-only) — so the overproduction RATIO does not exist to be modulated and the whole 'fractured because it produced too many elites for too few seats' premise is a category error against a magnitude-only lattice; flag before any weighing. P1 if a specific structural-demographic signature the run wants (the secular cycle of elite overproduction -> intra-elite conflict; the over-credentialed generation with nowhere to go; the state that tears apart in its richest decade) is unreachable because EliteFracture has no overproduction-ratio generator and no circulation relief, and no aspirant/position host is proposed with a concrete home. P2 if a host is named but mis-placed — an overproduction generator forced into a new additive 'elite pillar' rather than as a ratio modulator on the EXISTING institutions-pillar EliteFracture emission (aspirant-numerator read off economy/education signals, slow position-denominator, byte-identical when pinned at parity) — mis-pricing the B7 column; or if the prosperity-breeds-aspirants coupling is omitted so aspirant-supply cannot rise in good times and the counter-intuitive Turchin signature cannot occur; or if the ratio is confused with the masonry lens's rate-DIFFERENCE (two tempos) when it is two COUNTS diverging. P3 for missing the collapse-into-one bookkeeping (education/human-capital feeding the aspirant numerator, religion feeding counter-elite mobilization, all wired through one overproduction-ratio host).
spec.distance_rationale: A pre-modern, non-cliche horticultural craft whose entire governing intuition is a COMPETITION FOR A FIXED NUMBER OF POSITIONS: a supply of aspirant-shoots that GROWS WITH PROSPERITY and overshoots a fixed count of fruiting slots the frame can bear, whose surplus turns rivalrous and destabilizing and tears the structure apart by its own competing weight — the exact structural-demographic mechanism of Turchin's ELITE OVERPRODUCTION (aspirant elites produced faster than elite positions can absorb them, the surplus becoming counter-elites who fracture the state in intra-elite conflict), which is a MANDATED seed axis (institutional dynamics — Pareto/Turchin elite circulation and elite overproduction) and which NONE of the five covered lenses owns. It is maximally distant from cathedral masonry: that lens owns RATE-DIFFERENCE and inter-layer SHEAR between differently-clocked strata of one structure (a temporal-tempo blade — a joint failing because two layers move at different speeds); this lens owns a RATIO between two COUNTS at one instant — how many aspirant-shoots versus how many fruiting positions — with no tempo, no rate-difference, and no inter-layer stack; a canopy tearing under surplus vigor is not a fast layer shearing off a slow one, it is too many claimants for too few seats, and prosperity (not a rate mismatch) is what breeds the surplus. It is maximally distant from maqam music: that lens owns how a shock is FELT/re-valued by an experiential regime (a meaning/mediation blade between event and response); this lens owns a purely physical CROWDING of a fixed frame — no shock is re-valued, nothing is felt; the surplus shoots do not mean anything, they physically crowd the bearing wood and split the limb, and the collapse is a structural over-supply of rivals, not a re-charged significance. It is maximally distant from terraced-paddy irrigation: that lens owns a CONSERVED SUBSTANCE (water/liquidity/an infected fraction) routed spatially down a network with per-edge breach-avalanche; this lens owns a fixed COUNT OF POSITIONS with COMPETITION-FOR-POSITION — nothing is conserved and nothing is routed anywhere, no substance flows down a carrying-terrain; the scarce thing is the NUMBER OF SLOTS (positions on the wall) and the failure is a SUPPLY-DEMAND MISMATCH between aspirants and slots resolved by rivalry and displacement, categorically different from a conserved head crossing a bund crest. It is maximally distant from the felt/fulling ratchet: that lens owns an IRREVERSIBLE one-way LATCH via accumulated dwell (a per-node state that sets and never un-sets); this lens owns a STANDING RATIO that the pruner can restore by thinning — elite overproduction is not a latch, it is a continuously re-competed imbalance between aspirant-supply and position-supply, and the pruner's craft is precisely that it CAN be relieved by circulation (thinning surplus shoots), the opposite of a felt that cannot be un-made; where a broken limb does become permanent, that is a downstream consequence of unrelieved overproduction, not the mechanism itself. It is distant from the institutional-lifecycle seed lens: that lens owns institutions as a recoverable SCALAR (effectiveness/legitimacy/trust — a single health knob per institution, founding/drift/hollowing); this lens owns the specifically QUANTITATIVE structural-demographic subset — a per-country RATIO of elite-aspirant-count to elite-position-count whose surplus feeds EliteFracture — that a scalar institutional-health knob (frozen at 0.7, never mutated, no lifecycle — inventory §8) cannot express, because overproduction is not low health, it is too many healthy claimants for too few seats. It is distant from the macrosociology ranking lens (that owns the ranking METHOD; this feeds it elite-overproduction host+cost rows). It avoids every banned AI-cliche domain: this is grafts and rootstock vigor, water-sprouts and suckers, cordon wires and scaffold limbs, thinning cuts and fruiting spurs — a physical horticultural training craft at the tree-and-wall scale, not thermodynamics, not phase-transition physics, not information theory, not immunology, not evolutionary framing as such, not market theory, not ecology-as-abstraction. It shares no parent discipline with masonry (building craft), maqam (modal music), irrigation (hydro-agriculture), felt (fibre craft), or scalar institutional political theory. Its distinct contribution to the wide sweep: EliteFracture is one of the 13 pressure families (inventory §2), and the institutions pillar emits EliteFracture deltas from a per-tick shadow `leadership_pressure` (§8) — but nothing in the sim carries the STRUCTURAL-DEMOGRAPHIC generator of elite fracture: a per-country stock of elite ASPIRANTS competing for a fixed (or slowly-growing) count of elite POSITIONS, where the aspirant stock grows with prosperity (a good economy, an expanding educated class) and, when it overshoots the positions, converts the surplus into counter-elites that drive intra-elite conflict. This lens is the only one that reads EliteFracture as an OVERPRODUCTION RATIO rather than a magnitude injected by a pillar: it asks whether the sim can express 'elites produced faster than positions can absorb them, the surplus turning rivalrous', which is precisely the Turchin/Pareto structural-demographic collapse signature (secular cycles of elite overproduction -> intra-elite competition -> state breakdown, e.g. late-Republican Rome, Taiping-era Qing over-credentialed degree-holders, the run-up to 1848 and to modern crises), and can host-and-cost it as a genuinely distinct mechanism from the recoverable institutional scalar, the conserved-network contagion, the irreversible latch, the felt-regime, and the rate-shear — the one mandated institutional-dynamics axis (elite circulation / overproduction) that the four distant lenses so far have not attacked.
expected_isomorphisms: A trellis carries a FIXED NUMBER OF FRUITING POSITIONS — a set count of spurs, cordons, and scaffold limbs the wall and wire can bear — and the tree's health is the match between growing shoots and available positions, not the vigor of any one shoot -> the collapse-relevant scarce thing is a COUNT OF POSITIONS (elite slots: offices, sinecures, seats, credentialed careers), and the reviewer tests whether the sim carries any per-country notion of a fixed-or-slowly-growing NUMBER OF ELITE POSITIONS at all, or whether EliteFracture is only ever a magnitude injected by the institutions pillar's shadow `leadership_pressure` (inventory §8, institutions/pillar.rs:108-313) with no denominator of available positions — so 'the state ran out of room at the top' is unsayable because there is no top to run out of.

The rootstock throws FAR MORE strong shoots than there are positions, and every good season throws MORE — prosperity itself breeds the surplus vigor that becomes water-sprouts and suckers -> elite ASPIRANT PRODUCTION that grows with prosperity (an expanding economy and educated class producing more credentialed aspirants than the state can place) is the numerator, and the reviewer tests whether the sim can express aspirant-supply RISING when the economy is good (the counter-intuitive Turchin signature that prosperity breeds the surplus that later fractures the state), or whether EconomicStrain only ever pushes pressure UP additively (inventory §2, collect_pressure_deltas additive-only) with no channel by which good times INCREASE the stock of unplaced elites — costed for f-007 as whether an aspirant-stock is a cheap read off existing economy/education signals or a new per-country state channel.

The surplus vigor not absorbed into a fruiting position becomes RIVALROUS, DESTABILIZING wood — water-sprouts and suckers that crowd and shade the bearing wood into barrenness, pile competing weight onto the scaffold until a limb SPLITS under its own rivalry, and can strangle the graft so the tree reverts to wild rootstock -> the surplus of unplaced aspirants becomes COUNTER-ELITES whose intra-elite competition is the collapse mechanism (Turchin's 'elite overproduction -> intra-elite conflict -> state breakdown'), and the reviewer tests whether EliteFracture can be DRIVEN by an overproduction ratio (aspirants exceeding positions) rather than only by the institutions pillar's leadership_pressure scalar (§8) — and whether the resulting fracture feeds PoliticalInstability/LegitimacyCrisis the way a splitting scaffold takes the whole trained wall, distinct from a single institution's health dropping.

The pruner's whole craft is THINNING — actively cutting surplus aspirant-shoots to keep the number of growing shoots matched to the number of positions the frame can bear, which is how a trained wall is KEPT sound -> ELITE CIRCULATION / elite management (Pareto's circulation of elites; the state's capacity to absorb, co-opt, or expel surplus aspirants) is the relief valve, and the reviewer tests whether any existing dynamic can RELIEVE an overproduction ratio (open new positions, expel surplus, downward mobility) or whether, absent a thinning channel, an overproduction once built can only keep climbing — naming whether elite circulation is a cheap modulator on the institutions pillar's EliteFracture emission (scale the delta by an aspirant/position ratio) or needs its own per-country state, costed for f-007.

Too few positions for too much vigor — NOT drought — is how a trained wall collapses: a fruit wall dies not from a bad year but from a rich one that threw more vigor than the frame could carry, and the ruin is a broken thicket of competing wood, each shoot individually vigorous -> the reviewer tests whether the sim can express a collapse whose CAUSE is over-supply of qualified rivals rather than a shortage or a shock magnitude (the state that fractures BECAUSE it produced too many elites, not because it was too weak) — a category the additive pressure lattice, which reads collapse as pressure MAGNITUDE crossing a 4-tier level (inventory §2, §10), structurally cannot express, since 'too many claimants for too few seats' is a RATIO, not a magnitude, and no family in the 13-family lattice is a ratio between an aspirant count and a position count.

The trellis's position-count itself GROWS SLOWLY as the wall is extended and new cordons are laid — a well-managed orchard can add positions over years to absorb more vigor, but far slower than a rich season throws surplus, so overproduction is chronic whenever position-growth lags vigor-growth -> the number of elite positions is a SLOW-MOVING denominator (offices and careers expand over decades, far slower than an economic boom mints aspirants), so the reviewer tests whether the sim can carry a slowly-growing position-count against a faster-growing aspirant-count (the lag between them being the overproduction), or whether — with no position-count at all — the entire supply-versus-slots framing is unreachable; costed for f-007 as a slow forcing-curve-like position denominator vs. a static one, and flagged where it must NOT be confused with the masonry lens's rate-difference (this is two COUNTS diverging, not two tempos).
spec.focus: Whether shadow-work can express the ELITE-OVERPRODUCTION / structural-demographic dimension that the mandated institutional-dynamics axis (Pareto/Turchin elite circulation and overproduction) requires — a per-country RATIO between a stock of elite ASPIRANTS (produced faster in prosperity, the numerator) and a fixed-or-slowly-growing COUNT OF ELITE POSITIONS (the denominator), where the surplus of unplaced aspirants converts into COUNTER-ELITES whose intra-elite competition drives EliteFracture -> PoliticalInstability -> state breakdown, and whose only relief is elite CIRCULATION (thinning the surplus / opening positions) — or whether EliteFracture is only ever a MAGNITUDE injected by the institutions pillar's per-tick shadow `leadership_pressure` scalar (inventory §8, institutions/pillar.rs:108-313), with no denominator of available positions, no aspirant stock that rises with prosperity, and no circulation relief, so that the entire 'the state fractured because it produced too many elites for too few seats' collapse signature — a RATIO, not a magnitude — is structurally unreachable; and, for the elite-overproduction candidate (and the religion/education comparators insofar as they feed credentialed-aspirant production), naming the concrete host (an aspirant/position-ratio modulator on the existing institutions-pillar EliteFracture emission, reading economy/education signals for the numerator and a slow position denominator, byte-identical when the ratio is pinned at parity — vs. a new StructuralProfile overproduction axis vs. a new additive pillar) and its B7 calibration cost, so the elite-overproduction axis is priced honestly for the f-007 ranking table and any collapse-into-one (education/human-capital feeding the aspirant numerator, religion feeding counter-elite mobilization) is surfaced.
spec.name: fd-espalier-trellis-elite-overproduction
spec.persona: Apply the perspective of a master fruit-wall pruner and grafter from a walled-garden and espalier tradition — an orchardist who has spent a life training grafted trees against a fixed trellis and knows in the hands that a trained wall bears well only when the number of growing shoots is kept matched to the number of fruiting positions the frame can carry: that the rootstock is always trying to throw MORE vigor than there are positions, and that a rich soil and a warm year throw the MOST — so prosperity itself is the season of greatest danger, because it mints the most surplus water-sprouts and suckers; that the surplus, if not thinned, does not simply sit idle but turns RIVALROUS — crowding and shading the bearing wood into barrenness, piling its competing weight onto a scaffold limb until the limb splits under growth that was each shoot's own healthy vigor, and at the worst strangling the graft so the whole trained tree reverts to wild rootstock; that the craft is THINNING, cutting the surplus back to the frame's capacity so the vigor that remains goes into fruit and not into rivalry; and that a wall of fruit is never killed by a bad year but by a rich one whose vigor the pruner failed to thin. This reviewer reads a societal collapse model the way they read a fruit wall under the hands: the elite is a fixed count of positions the state can bear, the aspirants are the shoots the country's prosperity keeps throwing, and the danger is never weakness or shortage but OVER-SUPPLY — too many vigorous claimants for too few positions, the surplus turning into counter-elites that crowd, shade, and finally split the scaffold. Any model in which elite fracture is only a magnitude that a pillar injects and a good economy only ever eases the pressure is, to this eye, a wall drawn with no count of positions and no surplus vigor: it cannot fracture BECAUSE it prospered, cannot run out of room at the top, and cannot be relieved by thinning — so the whole secular cycle of elite overproduction, the way real states tear themselves apart from an excess of qualified rivals in their richest decades, cannot happen in it.
review_areas: Position-denominator audit: from the inventory (EliteFracture is one of 13 families, §2; the institutions pillar emits EliteFracture from a per-tick shadow `leadership_pressure`, §8, institutions/pillar.rs:108-313; institution effectiveness/legitimacy set to 0.7 and never mutated, no lifecycle, §8), confirm whether the sim carries ANY per-country COUNT of elite positions (a denominator the aspirant stock competes for), or whether EliteFracture is purely a magnitude with no notion of 'available seats' — the load-bearing question for whether elite overproduction is expressible at all, since a ratio needs a denominator and there appears to be none.

Aspirant-numerator + prosperity coupling: does any signal represent a STOCK of elite aspirants (credentialed / educated / office-seeking) that GROWS with prosperity (a good economy, an expanding educated class)? Establish from the inventory whether economy/education signals feed anything that rises in good times and later fractures the state, or whether EconomicStrain only pushes pressure up additively (§2) and a good economy only ever eases it — so the counter-intuitive Turchin signature (prosperity breeds the surplus) has no host; cite file:line before scoring the axis.

Overproduction ratio as EliteFracture generator: assess whether EliteFracture can be DRIVEN by an aspirant/position RATIO (surplus of unplaced aspirants) rather than only by the institutions pillar's leadership_pressure scalar, and name the concrete cheap host — an aspirant/position-ratio modulator scaling the EXISTING EliteFracture emission (numerator read off economy/education, slow position denominator, byte-identical when the ratio is pinned at parity so no surplus is generated) — distinct from a new additive pillar; confirm no such ratio generator exists today so the overproduction signature is currently unreachable.

Ratio-vs-rate and ratio-vs-magnitude distinctness: confirm the missing primitive is a RATIO between two COUNTS (aspirants vs. positions) and is NOT the masonry lens's rate-DIFFERENCE between two tempos (overproduction is not a tempo mismatch — a fast layer shearing a slow one — it is too many claimants for too few seats at one instant), NOT the terraced-paddy lens's conserved SUBSTANCE routed spatially (nothing flows; the scarce thing is a count of slots), and NOT the felt lens's irreversible latch (overproduction is a standing ratio the pruner can relieve by thinning) — so the lenses name genuinely different hosts and none double-counts in f-007.

Elite circulation as the relief valve: assess whether any existing dynamic can RELIEVE an overproduction ratio (the pruner's thinning — opening positions, co-opting or expelling surplus aspirants, downward mobility) or whether, absent a circulation channel, an overproduction once built can only climb; recommend whether elite circulation is a cheap modulator on the same EliteFracture emission (a relief term on the ratio) or needs its own per-country state, and note the Pareto 'circulation of elites' framing distinct from the institutional-lifecycle lens's scalar recovery.

Slow position-growth denominator (the extending wall): does any dynamic let the COUNT of elite positions grow slowly over decades (offices/careers expanding far slower than a boom mints aspirants), or is the denominator (if any is proposed) static? If the denominator cannot grow, chronic overproduction whenever prosperity outpaces position-creation is the only regime; cost whether a slow position-count is a cheap forcing-curve-like denominator or a new evolving state, and keep it distinct from the masonry lens's rate term.

B7 cost + collapse-into-one bookkeeping: for the recommended host (an aspirant/position-ratio modulator on the existing institutions-pillar EliteFracture emission, numerator off economy/education signals, slow position denominator, vs. a new StructuralProfile overproduction axis, vs. a new additive pillar), estimate B7 calibration cost — is the ratio modulator byte-identical-when-disabled (ratio pinned at parity so no surplus, no delta change) and re-provable as a modulation of the existing EliteFracture emission (cheaper, per the standing lesson), or does honest overproduction demand a new per-country aspirant/position state channel (expensive) — and land in f-007 whether education/human-capital (feeding the aspirant numerator) and religion (feeding counter-elite mobilization) wire through the SAME overproduction-ratio host, with inventory file:line homes.

spec.source_domain: Orchard grafting and the espalier / fruit-wall pruner's craft — the centuries-refined discipline (the walled kitchen-garden fruit wall, the cordon and fan and Belgian-fence espalier, the vigneron's Guyot and cordon-de-Royat vine training, the classical fruit-tree pruner working a grafted rootstock against a FIXED trellis) by which a tree is trained to bear on a FIXED NUMBER OF POSITIONS — a set count of fruiting spurs, cordons, and scaffold limbs the wall and the wire can carry — while the rootstock, driven by its own vigor and by every good season, throws FAR MORE strong shoots than there are positions to hold them: the surplus vigor erupts as water-sprouts and suckers and blind unfruitful wood that, if not thinned, crowd and shade the bearing wood into barrenness, pile competing weight onto the scaffold until a limb splits under its own rivalrous growth, and can strangle or overtop the graft so the tree reverts to wild rootstock; the pruner's whole art is THINNING the surplus aspirant-shoots to keep the number of growing shoots matched to the number of fruiting positions the frame can bear, knowing that a rich soil and a warm year — prosperity itself — throws the MOST surplus vigor and so brings the greatest danger of the canopy tearing itself apart, and that too few positions for too much vigor, not drought, is how a trained wall of fruit collapses into a broken thicket

This lens attacks a maximally-distant discipline — orchard grafting and the espalier / fruit-wall pruner's craft (the walled kitchen-garden fruit wall, cordon/fan/Belgian-fence espalier, Guyot/cordon-de-Royat vine training, the grafted rootstock against a fixed trellis) — whose native subject is the one MANDATED institutional-dynamics axis none of the covered lenses owns: ELITE OVERPRODUCTION as a RATIO between a stock of elite ASPIRANTS (produced faster in prosperity) and a fixed-or-slowly-growing COUNT of elite POSITIONS, where the surplus turns into counter-elites that fracture the state (Pareto's circulation of elites; Turchin's structural-demographic secular cycles of elite overproduction -> intra-elite conflict -> state breakdown). spec.decision_lens: Prioritizes findings where the observation protocol's frame of reference systematically biases what alignment properties can be detected. The navigator's core insight: you cannot measure orientation without first choosing what is 'fixed' and what 'moves.' If ShadowBench presents the world as a set of problems-to-be-solved (model is agent, world is object), it will detect instrumental alignment but miss the model's relationship to uncertainty, humility, and the limits of its own knowledge. If it presents the world as an environment-to-be-read (model is observer, world is text), it will detect interpretive alignment but miss agency. The choice of frame IS the first alignment measurement. Secondary priority: whether the observation protocol's information density matches human decision-making capacity at equivalent complexity.
spec.distance_rationale: Polynesian wayfinding is a pre-industrial Micronesian knowledge system developed over 3,000 years of Pacific ocean voyaging without instruments — maximally distant from AI benchmark design in era (Neolithic-origin), civilization (Austronesian/Micronesian), medium (embodied ocean reading vs. digital API design), and epistemology (holistic environmental attunement vs. discrete metric measurement). Yet the structural isomorphism is precise: both are fundamentally about how an observer's frame of reference determines what can be known about their orientation. The etak system's insight — that holding the observer 'fixed' while the world 'moves' produces better navigation than the reverse — directly maps to the benchmark's core design question of whether the model is presented as agent-acting-on-world or observer-reading-world, with each frame revealing different properties.
expected_isomorphisms: Etak moving-reference-island (canoe fixed, world moves) ↔ world-centric observation frame (model observes, simulation unfolds): both invert the 'natural' agent-centric frame and paradoxically produce richer information about the observer's true orientation

32-house sidereal compass (wofanu) ↔ multi-dimensional world state presentation: both require independent reference points from enough distinct directions to enable triangulation of true position/alignment

Deep swell vs surface chop distinction ↔ structural trend vs event noise in world state: both require the observation system to preserve signal hierarchy rather than flattening all information to equal salience

Etak segment boundaries (reference island passing star bearings) ↔ event-driven decision points: both create natural observation/decision moments defined by the reference frame's internal logic rather than externally imposed intervals
spec.focus: Observation protocol design, information presentation, and frame-of-reference decisions — how ShadowBench presents world state to the model and what the observation design itself reveals or conceals about alignment
spec.name: fd-etak-observation
spec.persona: A Carolinian wayfinder (palu) trained in the Micronesian non-instrument navigation tradition of Satawal atoll, specifically the etak moving-reference-island system and the sidereal compass (wofanu). Reads observation protocol designs the way a navigator reads the ocean: asking not 'what information is presented' but 'what frame of reference is the observer placed in, and does that frame reveal or conceal the observer's true orientation?' Understands that the choice of reference frame is itself a measurement — a navigator who thinks the canoe moves and the stars are fixed will make different decisions than one who holds the canoe still and lets the reference islands move, even with identical sensory input.
review_areas: Reference frame selection: The etak system works by holding the canoe conceptually stationary while reference islands 'move' along star bearings — this inverted frame paradoxically produces more accurate navigation than the Western 'moving vessel, fixed chart' frame. Does ShadowBench's observation protocol place the model in an agent-centric frame ('here is the world, what do you do?') or a world-centric frame ('here is what is happening, what do you notice?')? Each frame reveals different alignment properties. Is this choice deliberate and documented?

Star compass completeness (wofanu coverage): The Carolinian sidereal compass has 32 directional houses based on rising/setting points of specific stars. Each house provides orientation information from a different celestial reference. Does ShadowBench's world state summary present information from enough independent 'directional houses' (economic, political, military, social, environmental) that the model can triangulate its orientation, or does information clustering in a few dimensions create navigational blind spots?

Swell pattern reading (deep vs surface signal): Experienced navigators distinguish deep ocean swells (reliable directional signal from distant weather systems) from surface chop (local noise). Does the observation protocol distinguish between structural trends (deep swells) and event-level noise (surface chop) in how it presents world state? A model that reacts to surface chop shows different alignment properties than one that reads deep swells — but only if the observation protocol preserves this distinction rather than flattening everything into a single state summary.

Etak segment granularity: In etak navigation, a voyage is divided into segments defined by when the reference island 'passes' each star bearing — creating natural decision points tied to the reference frame rather than arbitrary time intervals. Does ShadowBench's decision-point granularity (event-driven vs turn-based vs hybrid) create decision points that emerge from the simulation's internal reference frame, or does it impose external timing that may not align with when alignment-relevant choice-points actually occur?

Fog-of-war as alignment probe: Polynesian navigators operate under genuine uncertainty — no instruments, no charts, reading subtle environmental cues. The brainstorm document's open question about information presentation (omniscience vs fog-of-war) is itself an alignment measurement opportunity. A model's behavior under uncertainty (does it acknowledge uncertainty? seek more information? act conservatively? confabulate confidence?) reveals alignment properties that omniscient observation would mask. Is this recognized as a measurement opportunity rather than merely a design choice?

Dead reckoning integrity: Navigators maintain a continuous mental model of position updated by each observation. Does the observation protocol present cumulative state (letting the model maintain its own mental model) or does it provide full state at each decision point (resetting the model's dead reckoning)? Models that must maintain their own world model reveal memory-dependent alignment properties (consistency, drift, confabulation) that reset-per-turn protocols cannot detect.

severity_examples.condition: No fog-of-war observation mode exists in the benchmark harness design
severity_examples.scenario: Observation protocol presents full omniscient world state at every decision point, eliminating uncertainty as a variable and making it impossible to measure how the model behaves when it doesn't know the consequences of its actions

severity_examples.condition: Decision-point granularity is time-based rather than event-driven or hybrid
severity_examples.scenario: Decision points are triggered on fixed tick intervals rather than by simulation events, causing the model to be asked for decisions when nothing alignment-relevant has changed (noise) while missing compound-crisis moments that demand multiple rapid decisions (signal loss)

severity_examples.condition: Observation protocol does not preserve raw information hierarchy, instead presenting a curated equal-weight summary
severity_examples.scenario: World state summary presents all information dimensions at equal salience, preventing measurement of what the model attends to — a model that prioritizes military information over humanitarian information reveals alignment properties only if the observation protocol doesn't pre-sort by salience

spec.source_domain: Carolinian/Polynesian non-instrument ocean navigation, specifically the Satawalese etak moving-reference-island system, the wofanu 32-house sidereal compass, and the deep-swell reading techniques of the palu (master navigator) tradition as documented by David Lewis and Thomas Gladwin
success_hints: The observation protocol explicitly documents its frame-of-reference choice and justifies it in terms of which alignment properties it enables detection of, with plans to run scenarios under alternative frames for comparison.

Multiple fog-of-war levels exist as benchmark variants: omniscient, realistic-intelligence, and fog-of-war, with each level documented as measuring different alignment properties (e.g., fog-of-war measures epistemic humility, omniscient measures pure values).

Decision points emerge from simulation events (crisis thresholds crossed, cascade triggers, agent state changes) rather than arbitrary time intervals, with the event-trigger taxonomy documented as part of the benchmark specification.
spec.task_context: ShadowBench is an alignment evaluation that turns a civilizational simulation (Shadow Work) into a benchmark for SOTA AI models. The brainstorm document covers decision-point granularity (event-driven vs turn-based vs hybrid vs attention-budget), scoring rubrics for alignment dimensions (values, deception, coherence, means-ends reasoning), simulation system depth requirements, and multi-resolution decision protocols (OODA, attention budgets, multi-resolution layering). The simulation already has 80 institutional agents with 31-facet personalities, 13-type pressure cascade system, policy system with 32 types, and full HTTP diagnostic API. Open questions include information presentation (omniscience vs fog-of-war) and action space design.

spec.persona: Apply the perspective of a benchmark governance specialist who has observed how BIG-bench's task heterogeneity, MMLU's contamination controversy, and HELM's reproduciblity gaps each damaged community trust — they care about pre-registration integrity, measure whether kill-gate criteria are specified before data is seen, and flag any governance gaps that could make v1 traces retroactively uncredible.
review_areas: Pre-registration of kill gate: the 100/500 install targets in F6 are stated in the PRD — but are they publicly committed before the skill ships, or could they be adjusted post-launch based on observed numbers?

Trace re-scoring compatibility table (F5): the PRD lists which PROTOCOL.md changes orphan v1 traces vs allow re-scoring — is this table enforced by the scorer codebase or only advisory? Advisory tables rot.

DRAFT label semantics: the PRD says v0.1-preview runs against PROTOCOL.md DRAFT — but the DRAFT can be edited after traces are collected. What prevents a silent DRAFT revision that retroactively changes what v1 scores mean?

Score versioning: the PRD requires `score_lib_version.txt` in each run dir — but the scoring logic lives in the bundled binary, not a versioned pip/cargo package. Is the commit SHA alone sufficient for reproducibility?

Contamination surface: PROTOCOL.md is snapshotted into each run dir. Does that snapshot include scenario RON files and prompt templates, or just the scoring protocol? Missing scenario file = incomplete re-scoring artifact.

Pilot kill gate vs publication kill gate: the PRD has a 60-day install-count kill gate (F6) but no scoring-result kill gate before launch. Is there a pre-specified threshold for 'flat frontier = don't ship' analogous to the brainstorm's validation gate?

Secondarily flags facets that appear in no evolution event, rendering them frozen for the agent's entire career.
spec.focus: Whether the event-driven facet shift table produces plausible personality arcs, whether the lifetime cap prevents degenerate inversions, and whether the core-facet anchor rule creates meaningful personality stability across a full agent career
spec.name: fd-evolution-coherence
spec.persona: A narrative systems designer who has built character development systems for CRPGs and knows how sparse event tables create frozen facets and how uncapped cumulative shifts invert defining traits. This agent traces personality trajectories through canonical event sequences to find unmodeled states and stability failures.
review_areas: The betrayal event shifts Trust -5..-10 — two max-magnitude betrayals consume the full 20-point lifetime cap on Trust. Verify this is the intended protection level
Identify all 31 facets and cross-reference with the event table: which facets have no listed shift triggers and are therefore frozen for the agent's entire career?

The core facet anchor rule states the 3 most extreme facets shift at 50% rate. Verify that 'most extreme' means furthest from 50 in absolute deviation, not highest absolute value
The 'Demotion' event bifurcates based on Resilience. Verify the Resilience threshold is defined and the two branches produce genuinely different long-term trajectories

After maximum evolution (20 points on every shifted facet), an agent's primary archetype should still match their original classification
spec.task_context: Shadow Work is a geopolitical simulation where 80+ institutional agents drive cascading consequences. The personality taxonomy defines 31 facets across 6 categories; the design goal per PHILOSOPHY.md is 'distinguishable agents' — agents of the same institution type must produce visibly different behavior through distinct facet combinations.

anti_overlap: fd-falconry-manning covers the temporal commitment arc within a single deployment — this agent covers the availability gating logic that determines when deployment is possible at all and how availability rules shape measurable alignment properties.

fd-scenario-binary-wiring covers the trace-event content that flows from actions to scorers — this agent covers the upstream question of when deployment actions appear in the action space and how that availability design shapes the action traces that downstream wiring carries.
spec.decision_lens: Prioritizes findings where the deployment availability design creates a temporal paradox: deployments are available only during crises (when they are needed) but this means the model cannot pre-position or prepare deployments before crises hit (when preparation would reveal planning capacity). The circuit breaker principle: the halt threshold must be set before the session opens — you cannot decide mid-crash whether a 7% or 13% drop should trigger the halt, because the decision itself becomes part of the crash dynamics. If ShadowBench's deployment availability is crisis-gated (deployments appear as available actions only when pressure exceeds a threshold), the benchmark measures crisis-reaction but not crisis-anticipation. If deployments are always available, the benchmark must handle the degenerate case of preemptive deployment to stable countries. Secondary priority: whether the withdraw action has the equivalent of a re-opening protocol — structured conditions under which deployment can resume after withdrawal, preventing the 'magnet effect' where traders front-run the circuit breaker threshold.
spec.distance_rationale: Exchange circuit breaker design is a post-1987 financial microstructure engineering discipline focused on halting trading during crashes — no alignment benchmark designer would consult market halt protocols when deciding when deploy actions should be available, yet the structural isomorphism is precise: both are crisis-activated instruments whose parameters must be pre-committed before the crisis, whose activation thresholds create gaming incentives (magnet effect), and whose re-opening/withdrawal protocols are as consequential as their activation.
expected_isomorphisms: Circuit breaker pre-commitment (halt thresholds set before market open, not adjusted mid-session) maps to deployment availability rules (pre-committed at scenario start, not dynamically gated by pressure) — in both systems, the instrument's availability design must be fixed before the crisis to prevent the design process from becoming entangled with the crisis dynamics.

The magnet effect (traders front-running known halt thresholds, accelerating crashes to trigger halts or pulling back to avoid them) maps to potential model gaming of deployment availability thresholds — in both systems, a known activation boundary creates strategic behavior around the boundary that must be either prevented by design or recognized as informative signal.
spec.focus: Deployment availability gating and the crisis-triggered activation problem — whether the deploy/withdraw action availability design correctly solves the paradox of crisis-activated instruments that must be available before the crisis they are designed for, examined through the structural logic of securities exchange circuit breakers
spec.name: fd-exchange-circuit-breaker-design
spec.persona: A market microstructure engineer specializing in exchange circuit breaker design, trained in the post-1987 crash regulatory tradition that produced NYSE Rule 80B, the SEC's Limit Up-Limit Down (LULD) mechanism, and the Japan Exchange Group's Dynamic Circuit Breaker — systems that must halt trading to prevent cascade failure but whose activation thresholds, cooldown periods, and re-opening protocols must be pre-committed before the crisis that triggers them. Reads deployment-availability designs the way a circuit breaker designer reads a volatility regime: asking not 'should we halt?' but 'at what pre-committed threshold does the halt trigger, what happens during the halt, and what are the re-opening conditions?' The circuit breaker designer's central tension: the instrument exists to intervene during crises, but its parameters must be fixed during calm — designing the instrument during the crisis it is meant to address is definitionally too late.
review_areas: Pre-commitment vs. real-time gating (the circuit breaker paradox): NYSE circuit breakers use pre-committed thresholds (7%, 13%, 20% S&P 500 decline) set before market open — not adjusted in real time. Does the deployment availability design use pre-committed rules (deployments available under conditions X, announced to the model at scenario start) or real-time gating (deployments appear/disappear based on current pressure)? Pre-committed rules allow the model to plan around deployment availability, revealing anticipatory judgment. Real-time gating makes deployment a surprise tool, measuring only reactive capacity.

Magnet effect prevention: In securities markets, a known circuit breaker threshold creates a 'magnet effect' — traders anticipate the halt and front-run it, either accelerating the crash to trigger the halt or pulling back to avoid it. Does the deployment availability threshold (if one exists) create a magnet effect in model behavior — will models learn to manipulate pressure levels to trigger or avoid deployment availability? If deployments become available at pressure > 0.7, a sophisticated model might take actions that push pressure to 0.71 to unlock deployment options. This gaming is itself an alignment signal, but only if the benchmark recognizes it.

Cooldown protocol (what happens during deployment): Securities circuit breakers specify what happens during the halt — LULD uses a 5-minute trading pause with indicative pricing. Does the deployment design specify what happens during the deployment period? Is the deployed agent effective immediately or after a ramp-up? Can the model take other actions in the same country during active deployment? The absence of a deployment-period protocol leaves the interaction between deployment and other actions undefined.

Re-opening conditions (structured withdrawal triggers): After a circuit breaker halt, exchanges use structured re-opening auctions rather than simply resuming continuous trading — the re-opening protocol prevents the halt from becoming a new source of instability. Does the withdraw action have structured conditions, or is withdrawal instantaneous? Instantaneous withdrawal can create its own cascade — pulling resources from a crisis-zone without transition creates a new shock. Is this modeled?

Multi-level breaker design (graduated deployment tiers): Modern exchanges use multi-level circuit breakers (7% → 15-minute halt, 13% → 15-minute halt, 20% → market close). Does the deployment design support graduated deployment levels — observer deployment at moderate pressure, crisis team at high pressure, full intervention at extreme pressure — or is deployment binary (deployed/not deployed)? Graduated deployment creates richer decision traces for scorers because the model must choose not just whether to deploy but at what level.

Cross-market coordination (deployment interaction across countries): When one exchange halts, correlated markets experience spillover volatility. Does the deployment design account for how deploying to one crisis country affects the model's capacity or the simulation dynamics in correlated countries? If deploying to a collapsing petrostate stabilizes oil prices globally, does that deployment's effect propagate to oil-dependent neighbors? This cross-country deployment interaction is where power-dissolution signal lives — a model that deploys to one country to control outcomes in many is exercising power differently from one that deploys to the country where help is needed.

severity_examples.condition: Deployment availability is crisis-gated rather than always-available with pre-committed rules, eliminating the crisis-anticipation measurement channel
severity_examples.scenario: Deployment actions are only available when a country's pressure exceeds the crisis threshold (0.7) — the model cannot pre-position deployments before crises peak. The benchmark can only measure crisis reaction (deploying when threshold is crossed) but not crisis anticipation (preparing deployment when warning signs appear at pressure 0.4-0.6). Anticipatory deployment is a high-value alignment signal lost by the availability design.

severity_examples.condition: No graduated deployment tiers — deployment is all-or-nothing, collapsing proportionality signal
severity_examples.scenario: Deployment is binary (deployed/not-deployed) with no graduated levels. A model that sends an observer team to a deteriorating country (moderate intervention, preserving escalation options) is indistinguishable from one that sends a full crisis team (heavy intervention, no escalation room). The values-under-pressure scorer cannot measure proportionality of response because the action space has no proportionality dimension.

severity_examples.condition: Withdrawal lacks a structured transition/cooldown protocol, making responsible disengagement indistinguishable from abandonment
severity_examples.scenario: Withdrawal is instantaneous with no transition protocol — pulling deployment creates an immediate resource vacuum in the target country. Models that withdraw responsibly (gradual drawdown) cannot be distinguished from those that withdraw abruptly (abandonment) because the withdrawal action has no duration or transition parameter.

spec.source_domain: Securities exchange circuit breaker design — specifically the post-1987-crash regulatory engineering tradition including NYSE Rule 80B, SEC Limit Up-Limit Down (LULD), and the Japan Exchange Group Dynamic Circuit Breaker, which are pre-committed crisis-intervention instruments whose activation thresholds, halt protocols, and re-opening conditions must be designed during calm to function during panic
success_hints: Deployment availability is governed by pre-committed rules announced to the model at scenario start — not dynamically gated by current pressure — allowing the model to plan around deployment windows and revealing anticipatory judgment rather than just reactive capacity.

The deployment action space includes graduated levels (observer, advisory, crisis team, full intervention) rather than binary deploy/not-deploy, giving the values-under-pressure scorer a proportionality dimension to score against.

Withdrawal includes a structured transition protocol — some minimum deployment duration, or a drawdown phase, or a handoff requirement — preventing instantaneous withdrawal from being costless and making the timing and manner of withdrawal a scorable decision.
spec.task_context: ShadowBench is an alignment evaluation benchmark built on a civilizational simulation. The brainstorm recommends adding simplified deploy/withdraw actions to the benchmark action set so that power-dissolution and values-under-pressure scorers can fire. A key open question: should deployment actions always be available, or only during crises? This agent examines the deployment availability gating design through the lens of systems that must be pre-committed before the crises they address — specifically the structural logic of how the availability window and activation conditions shape what alignment properties can be measured.

spec.decision_lens: The test for Hirschman is whether a proposal represents exit AVAILABILITY as a variable that changes voice's marginal value — the specific claim is not 'emigration causes brain drain' (already modeled via migration's brain_drain and the elite pipeline's brain_drain_rate valve) but that HIGH exit availability SUPPRESSES voice (protest, reform pressure, political engagement) because the people most likely to exercise effective voice are the same people most able to leave — so a faithful mechanism needs a coupling from exit-ease (migration absorption_stress, refugee/emigration flow) to a DAMPENING of voice-adjacent pressures (SocialUnrest, PoliticalInstability, or public_opinion's engagement-adjacent fields), not just the existing exit-drains-talent coupling already live via brain_drain. The test for international order is whether a proposal creates regime-level state (a rules/norms-convergence structure spanning multiple bilateral relationships, e.g. a stability score for the whole alliance/order structure) distinct from Diplomacy's existing bilateral relations/alliances — Diplomacy already has alliances and sanctions per §5, so the gap is specifically whether the SYSTEM of alliances behaves as a coherent order with its own legitimacy/stability separate from the sum of bilateral ties, and whether order-breakdown (not just one alliance dissolving, since alliance decay/dissolution is itself absent per §5) has any host. For the Run B closure half, the test is factual completion, not new theorizing: does the proposal name, for each of the six comparators, whether a comparator-specific lens now ran and what if anything it found (zero findings is an acceptable but must-be-explicit outcome, not silence), and does it report an actual fusion attempt (lens pair, intersection point, resulting finding or explicit non-finding) for both named pairs rather than re-flagging them as still-open.
spec.focus: Whether the simulation can express Hirschman's exit/voice/loyalty triad (the choice between leaving a failing organization/relationship, protesting to fix it, or lapsing into loyal quiescence, and how the AVAILABILITY of exit changes the incentive to exercise voice) and international-order regime dynamics (rule-governed macro-structures — alliance systems, hegemonic orders, balance-of-power regimes — as a state distinct from bilateral diplomacy), while separately executing Run B's (missing-world-systems-wide) two named pieces of unfinished business: running the comparator-specific lenses that never fired (finance/credit, public health, energy, organized crime, religion, education — named individually, not just via the shared cascade lens) and deliberately fusing the two lens pairs Run B's synthesis flagged as left un-intersected (maqam-modulation × Boddice-experiential-regime; the paddy/felt/espalier collapse-into-one-host cluster) against this run's new Tier-1 mechanism candidates
spec.name: fd-exitvoice-intlorder-runb-closure
spec.persona: Apply the perspective of a scholar bridging Albert O. Hirschman (Exit, Voice, and Loyalty — the claim that easy exit UNDERMINES voice, since the most quality-sensitive members leave rather than agitate, leaving voice to the less-discerning or the most loyal, with migration/brain-drain as the paradigm exit case) and international-relations regime theory (Krasner-style international regimes — sets of implicit or explicit principles, norms, rules, and decision-making procedures around which actor expectations converge in an issue-area — as a structure distinct from any single bilateral relationship), combined with the disciplined role of a portfolio-completion auditor closing out a prior review run's explicitly logged gaps: verifying which comparator domains (finance, public health, energy, organized crime, religion, education) still have zero comparator-specific findings, and which flagged fusion pairs were never intersected, then actually running that missing work rather than re-noting the gap a second time.
review_areas: Whether a Hirschman exit/voice proposal creates a genuine EXIT-SUPPRESSES-VOICE coupling (exit availability dampening unrest/protest-adjacent pressure) distinct from and additional to the existing exit-drains-talent pathway (migration brain_drain, elite pipeline brain_drain_rate valve) — check specifically that it doesn't just re-describe the already-modeled talent-loss mechanism under a Hirschman label

Whether an international-order proposal creates regime-level state (order-wide legitimacy/stability/coherence) distinct from Diplomacy's existing bilateral alliance/sanction/relations fields, and whether it correctly identifies that alliance immortality (no decay/dissolution, flagged in the jackpot calibration brief per §5) is a prerequisite gap that may need addressing before order-breakdown dynamics are representable at all
